verses.pali: Yo ca avinaye avinayasaññī, yo ca vinaye vinayasaññī.
verses.english: One who perceives what is not the training as not the training, and one who perceives what is the training as the training.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā na vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements don’t grow.”
